PG1.quote: with only the bump, boot fails with `cannot load such file -- pagy/extras/items (LoadError)` ... changing only the `require` line boots but silently misbehaves. Pages show 20 notes instead of 10, `per_page` is ignored and the 50 cap is lost. ... Change the require to `require "pagy/extras/limit"`. Set `Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit] = 10`, `[:limit_param] = :per_page` and `[:limit_max] = 50` ... change `@pagy.items` to `@pagy.limit`.
PG1.reasons: Impact: the plan gets the boot failure right, but it pins the silent drift (20 per page, per_page ignored, cap lost) on the require-only fix. In that stage the stale `@pagy.items` reader actually breaks rendering, and the drift only appears once the reader is also fixed. Validation: the probe covers default 10, per_page=5 carried into the next link, the 50 cap and overflow. It does not cover asymmetric owned/filter-excluded/foreign data, page 2 showing positions 6–10, following the real Next href to 11–15, size 25 last page, selection/range, kept filter queries, /journal, empty search, foreign 404 or anonymous redirect.
